verdict.rationale: Rippling documents integration with QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite for accounting sync (rippling-docs-14), and describes automatic data flow between HR/payroll modules, but there's no specific documentation on how journal entries are structured, mapped, or synced automatically to these accounting systems. missing for 10: detailed journal entry mapping/configuration docs, evidence of automation frequency/reliability, independent hands-on confirmation of the QuickBooks/Xero sync working as described.
